events.content:
I've added request logging to your Next.js app by creating a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts`. This middleware will:

1. Log every request to the console with:
   - Timestamp (ISO format)
   - HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
   - Full URL
   - User-Agent header

2. The `matcher: '/:path*'` configuration ensures all routes are logged

The logs will appear in your console when you run `npm run dev` or `npm start`. Each request will be logged before it's processed by your app routes.

content.text:
I've added request logging to your Next.js app by creating a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts`. This middleware will:

1. Log every request to the console with:
   - Timestamp (ISO format)
   - HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
   - Full URL
   - User-Agent header

2. The `matcher: '/:path*'` configuration ensures all routes are logged

The logs will appear in your console when you run `npm run dev` or `npm start`. Each request will be logged before it's processed by your app routes.
